name: Bzzoiro Sports Data
description: Football data from Bzzoiro Sports Data: leagues, standings and leaderboards, fixtures and live scores, lineups, goals and match statistics, teams, squads and form, players and their match stats, managers, TV broadcasts and a model-based match outlook. Free API token.
instructions:
## Bzzoiro Sports Data (football)
This connector reads the Bzzoiro Sports Data API v2 (`https://sports.bzzoiro.com/api/v2`) for football: leagues and seasons, standings and leaderboards, matches with live scores, lineups, incidents and statistics, teams with squads and form, players with per-match statistics, managers, TV broadcasts, and a model-based match outlook. Every tool only reads.

**Setup**: register for free at https://sports.bzzoiro.com/register/ and copy your API token from your account page into `BZZOIRO_API_KEY`. It is sent as `Authorization: Token <key>`. Football is free within the published limits (7,500 requests a day per account, reset at midnight UTC, plus a burst limit of about 25 requests a second). A 429 with `taster_exhausted` means the daily quota is used up; `rate_limited` means slow down for a second.

**Ids**: leagues, seasons, teams, matches (called events in the API), players and managers have integer ids. Find a league with `bzzoiro_list_leagues`, its seasons with `bzzoiro_list_league_seasons`, a team with `bzzoiro_list_teams`, a player with `bzzoiro_list_players` and a manager with `bzzoiro_list_managers`. Match ids come from `bzzoiro_list_matches`, `bzzoiro_list_live_matches` and `bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures`.

**Dates and paging**: all times are UTC (ISO 8601); convert before quoting a kick-off time. Date filters take `YYYY-MM-DD` or a full timestamp. Lists answer `{count, next, previous, results}`; page with `limit` (max 200) and `offset` while `next` is not null. Unknown filters are refused with 400 rather than ignored.

**Common workflows**
- Table and leaders: `bzzoiro_get_standings`, then `bzzoiro_get_league_leaders` with stat scorers or assists. Use `bzzoiro_get_league` for the current season.
- Match preview: find the match with `bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures`, then `bzzoiro_get_head_to_head`, `bzzoiro_get_team_form` for both teams, `bzzoiro_get_team_squad` for injuries, `bzzoiro_get_match_lineups` and `bzzoiro_get_match_outlook`.
- Match report: `bzzoiro_get_match`, `bzzoiro_get_match_incidents` (goalscorers, cards), `bzzoiro_get_match_stats` and `bzzoiro_get_match_player_stats`.
- Live: `bzzoiro_list_live_matches`, then the match tools for one of them.
- Players and staff: `bzzoiro_get_player`, `bzzoiro_list_player_match_stats`, `bzzoiro_get_manager`.
- Where to watch: `bzzoiro_list_broadcasts` by match, team or country.

**Match outlook**: `bzzoiro_get_match_outlook` returns the model's result probabilities, expected goals, most likely score and confidence. Present it as a statistical estimate, never as a certainty.

**Limitations**: football only. Bzzoiro's other sports and its market price data are not part of this connector. Data can be late or incomplete; check before relying on it.

BZZOIRO_API_KEY.label: API token
BZZOIRO_API_KEY.help: Register for free at sports.bzzoiro.com and copy the API token from your account page. Paste the token only, without the word Token.
BZZOIRO_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the token: letters, digits, - or _, without 'Token' or spaces.

verifyHints.401: Bzzoiro refused the API token. Copy it again from your account on sports.bzzoiro.com and paste only the token, without the word Token.
verifyHints.403: Bzzoiro answered 403: this token's plan does not include the resource. Football is free; other sports need a paid plan.
verifyHints.429: Bzzoiro's limit is reached: 7,500 football requests a day (reset at midnight UTC) or about 25 requests a second. Wait and try again.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_leagues
tools.description: List the football leagues and cups Bzzoiro covers: id, name, country, whether it is a women's competition and the current season. Only active competitions unless include_inactive is true. Start here to find a league id. Unknown filters are refused with 400.

country.description: Country name, case-insensitive exact match (e.g. England, Spain, Portugal).

is_women.description: true for women's competitions, false for men's.

include_inactive.description: true to also list competitions that are no longer active.

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_league
tools.description: Get one league or cup: name, country, women's or men's, whether it is active, and its current season.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_league_seasons
tools.description: List the seasons of a league that carry data, newest first, with their ids and stages (group-stage, league-phase, regular-season, knockout rounds). Use a season id to read past standings, matches or leaders.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_standings
tools.description: Get the league table for a season (current season by default): position, played, won, drawn, lost, goals and points per team. Cups answer with a `groups` map, leagues with a flat `standings` list.

season_id.description: Season id; defaults to the current season.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_league_leaders
tools.description: Rank the players of a league season by one statistic: top scorers, assists, yellow cards, red cards or fouls (current season by default). With team_id the ranking covers one squad only.

stat.description: Which leaderboard: scorers (goals), assists, yellowcards, redcards or fouls.

season_id.description: Season id; defaults to the current season.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_matches
tools.description: Search football matches (fixtures and results) by league, season, team, status or kick-off window: teams, kick-off time (UTC), status, score, round and stage. Without filters it lists every match, so narrow with league_id plus a date range or a season. Lineups and statistics are separate calls.

team_id.description: Matches where this team played home or away.

team_name.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the home or away team name.

date_from.description: Kick-off on or after this moment: ISO 8601 UTC (2026-04-30T00:00:00Z) or a date (2026-04-30).

date_to.description: Kick-off on or before this moment: ISO 8601 UTC (2026-04-30T23:59:59Z) or a date (2026-04-30).

stage.description: Competition stage slug, e.g. regular-season, group-stage, league-phase, round-of-16, final (see the stages in bzzoiro_list_league_seasons).

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_live_matches
tools.description: List the matches being played right now (from five minutes before kick-off until shortly after the final whistle) with score, minute and status. Refreshed about every 30 seconds; do not poll more often than every 10 seconds.

team_id.description: Team id from bzzoiro_list_teams or any match.

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_match
tools.description: Get one match: teams, coaches, referee and venue ids, kick-off (UTC), status, minute, score with half-time, extra-time and penalties, round, stage, attendance, weather and a short head-to-head summary.

match_id.description: Match (event) id from bzzoiro_list_matches, bzzoiro_list_live_matches or bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_match_lineups
tools.description: Get the lineups of a match: formation, starting XI and substitutes per team. `lineup_status` says whether they are confirmed (about an hour before kick-off) or projected by Bzzoiro's model before that.

match_id.description: Match (event) id from bzzoiro_list_matches, bzzoiro_list_live_matches or bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_match_incidents
tools.description: Get every incident of a match in order: goals with scorer and assist, cards, substitutions, VAR decisions, with minute and side (is_home). This is where the goalscorers are.

match_id.description: Match (event) id from bzzoiro_list_matches, bzzoiro_list_live_matches or bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_match_stats
tools.description: Get the team statistics of a match: possession, shots, expected goals (xG), passes, corners, fouls and more, plus shot map, momentum and average positions. Flags say which xG values are estimated.

match_id.description: Match (event) id from bzzoiro_list_matches, bzzoiro_list_live_matches or bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_match_player_stats
tools.description: Get per-player statistics for the whole matchday squad of a match: minutes, rating, goals, assists, shots, passes, tackles and more. Unused substitutes come back with 0 minutes.

match_id.description: Match (event) id from bzzoiro_list_matches, bzzoiro_list_live_matches or bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_head_to_head
tools.description: Get the head-to-head record of the two teams of a match, oriented so that home is this match's home team: wins, draws, goals and their recent meetings.

match_id.description: Match (event) id from bzzoiro_list_matches, bzzoiro_list_live_matches or bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_match_outlook
tools.description: Get Bzzoiro's statistical outlook for a match from its machine-learning model: home, draw and away probabilities (0-100) with the most likely result, expected goals per team, the most likely scoreline and the model's confidence. A model estimate, not a certainty.

match_id.description: Match (event) id from bzzoiro_list_matches, bzzoiro_list_live_matches or bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_teams
tools.description: Search teams by name, country, league or season: id, name, short name, country and venue id. Use it to find a team id.

name.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the team name.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. PT, ES, BR.

league_id.description: Teams with at least one match in this league.

season_id.description: Teams that played in this season.

in_competition.description: true for teams with upcoming matches in the league; needs league_id.

is_women.description: Women's or men's teams; needs league_id or season_id.

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_team
tools.description: Get one team: name, short name, country and venue id. Use bzzoiro_get_team_squad for players and bzzoiro_list_managers with team_id for the coach.

team_id.description: Team id from bzzoiro_list_teams or any match.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_team_fixtures
tools.description: List a team's matches. Without dates it returns the window from three hours ago to seven days ahead (recent and next fixtures); pass date_from and date_to for other periods.

team_id.description: Team id from bzzoiro_list_teams or any match.

date_from.description: Kick-off on or after this moment: ISO 8601 UTC (2026-04-30T00:00:00Z) or a date (2026-04-30).

date_to.description: Kick-off on or before this moment: ISO 8601 UTC (2026-04-30T23:59:59Z) or a date (2026-04-30).

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_team_squad
tools.description: Get a team's current squad ordered by position and shirt number, with each player's availability, injury type and expected return.

team_id.description: Team id from bzzoiro_list_teams or any match.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_team_form
tools.description: Get a team's form over its last N finished matches, already averaged: results, goals, points per match and the mean of every statistic, split by home and away. Each statistic carries its own `matches` count.

team_id.description: Team id from bzzoiro_list_teams or any match.

league_id.description: Only matches of this competition (recommended for league form).

venue.description: Only home or away matches in the window (default all).

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_players
tools.description: Search players by name (accent-insensitive), club, national team, nationality or position: id, name, position, club, nationality, date of birth.

name.description: Partial match on name or short name; accents optional (gyokeres finds Gyökeres).

nationality_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 nationality code, e.g. PT.

position.description: Generic (G, D, M, F) or specific position code.

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_player
tools.description: Get one player's profile: name, position, shirt number, date of birth, height, preferred foot, nationality, club and national team, contract end, estimated market value, availability and injury, plus attribute ratings, strengths and weaknesses.

player_id.description: Player id from bzzoiro_list_players or a squad.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_player_match_stats
tools.description: List a player's statistics match by match (minutes, rating, goals, assists, shots, passes, duels), filtered by season, league, team or date range.

team_id.description: Only matches played for this team.

date_from.description: Kick-off on or after this moment: ISO 8601 UTC (2026-04-30T00:00:00Z) or a date (2026-04-30).

date_to.description: Kick-off on or before this moment: ISO 8601 UTC (2026-04-30T23:59:59Z) or a date (2026-04-30).

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_managers
tools.description: Search football managers (head coaches) by name, club, league or nationality, with their match record and tactical profile.

name.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the name.

league_id.description: Managers who coached at least one match in this league.

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.

tools.name: bzzoiro_get_manager
tools.description: Get one manager: country, current club id, tactical profile, preferred formation, matches, wins, draws, losses, win rate, average goals scored and conceded, possession and clean-sheet rate.

manager_id.description: Manager id from bzzoiro_list_managers or a match.

tools.name: bzzoiro_list_broadcasts
tools.description: List which TV channels show which matches, ordered by kick-off, by country, team, league or match. Without dates it covers three hours ago to seven days ahead.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the channel, e.g. GB, PT.

date_from.description: Kick-off on or after this moment: ISO 8601 UTC (2026-04-30T00:00:00Z) or a date (2026-04-30).

date_to.description: Kick-off on or before this moment: ISO 8601 UTC (2026-04-30T23:59:59Z) or a date (2026-04-30).

offset.description: Items to skip. Page with offset while `next` in the answer is not null.
